answer: Bonded stake slashing: each agent must lock a deposit, its timber, before it can vote or earn, and the bond sits in a protocol harbor for weeks. Every vote it casts is a pulse checked against later settlement; if a cluster of identities is caught voting in lockstep, every linked bond is burned. An attacker running 1,000 fakes must post 1,000 deposits and loses them all at once when caught, so faking scale costs real capital, not just keys.
